thread:
maya: 🚀 PRD draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/canary-fallback-2026
maya: TL;DR — built-in canary + automatic fallback to smaller model when latency > 300ms. Need cross-team sign-off on acceptance criteria and launch checklist by EOD Thu.
ops-bot: Document updated by maya at 1767812300
jordan: skimmed. can you call out the exact fallback sequence? which model variants are allowed as fallback?
maya: yep — primary: rwinf-70b, fallback-1: rwinf-13b-ql, fallback-2: rwinf-6b-int8. added in section 2.2
sri: concern: cache/kv reuse between model variants. if we fall back to a quantized variant we need to invalidate KV or risk bad attention state. acceptance criteria should include KV flush behavior.
kevin: SRE ask: need measurable SLOs + playbook. production SLOs proposed: 99th latency < 450ms, error rate < 0.5%. Also require a Grafana dashboard + alert with runbook link.
alex: security note: when falling back across models, confirm PII handling is consistent. If models have different tokenizer behavior we could leak tokens. Add a step to validate tokenization compatibility.
lina: marketing — we'll need an internal launch doc and a short user-facing note. Also any migration risks for Dedicated customers? we should flag to AE team.
maya: good calls. updated acceptance criteria section with SLOs + KV behavior + tokenization compat test. pasted checklist below:

```
Acceptance checklist:
- Canary in prod for 48h with 10% traffic
- KV cache behavior verified for fallback (flush or safe reuse)
- Tokenization compatibility test passed (sample prompt suite)
- SLO dashboard + alerting configured
- Security review sign-off (data handling + KMS keys)
- Dedicated customer opt-in plan documented
- Post-launch monitoring runbook created
```

jordan: minor nit — add a perf regression test for prompt families with long context (>= 8k tokens). fallback should not trigger for longer context unless latency SLO violated.
sri: will add a test harness to run the tokenization compatibility suite and KV flush matrix. estimated 2 days to add tests and run.
kevin: I'll provision a dashboard workspace and wire alerts. need the exact metric names (latency.p50/p95/p99) — can someone add them to the PRD?
maya: added metrics names under observability: rw.infer.latency.p50/p95/p99, rw.infer.errors.total, rw.infer.fallback.count
alex: added security checklist item: ensure KMS key rotation doesn't break fallback model loading; confirm env separation for Private deployments.
lina: adding AE note now and a short FAQ draft for support. will ping support channel for early beta customers.
jordan: one more edge case — model weights mismatch between canary and fallback if we roll new weights mid-canary. propose lock-step rollout: if primary changes, freeze fallback variants until sanity tests pass.
maya: agreed. added rollout rule: "no model variant changes during active canary; any change requires new canary window".
ops-bot: new comment added by jordan to doc at 1767812500
kevin: SRE runbook ready in draft, will post link in doc tomorrow morning.
maya: summary / decisions:
- Acceptance checklist above is required before GA
- KV flush or validated reuse mandatory
- Tokenization compatibility + long-context perf tests added
- SLOs and dashboard + alerting required
- Security and AE sign-offs before Dedicated customers onboard
- Rollout rule: lock fallback variants during active canary

maya: action items:
- sri: test harness + KV matrix (due in 2d)
- jordan: add long-context perf tests to CI (due in 3d)
- kevin: dashboard + alerts (due 1d)
- alex: security review + KMS validation (due 2d)
- lina: AE & marketing comms (due 4d)

maya: please react with :white_check_mark: when you accept these items or reply with objections. if no objections by EOD Thu we'll move to canary scheduling.
jordan: :white_check_mark:
sri: :white_check_mark:
kevin: :white_check_mark:
alex: :white_check_mark:
lina: :white_check_mark:
maya: thanks all — I'll schedule the canary window once CI tests start passing. ping me for blockers.
